text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, what amazing weather! Perfect for

observing my cute little Umas. ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp! According to my sensors, there's an Uma nearby! I must hurry to the source!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Siriuuus! Sirius, where are youuu?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I want nothing more than to go partner
running
with you right now! I know you'll
treat me to a real
thrashing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, what's all this noise? ...Well,
nothing
that concerns a princess, I'm
sure.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time to start my special
training! Mr.
Tree, it is time for your
gracious beating.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Princess Smack! ☆
What the?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'd understand a beetle falling out of the
tree, but
not a Sirius Symboli!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Can't say I've been mistaken for a beetle
before.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Geez, just when I find a place to be
alone, I'm
immediately ambushed.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that's strange coming from you.
You're
always the center of attention, so
I thought you
preferred it that way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, even I need time to be alone
and
think. So could you keep my
hideout a secret?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If not... I'll have to make sure you keep
that
mouth of yours shut.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gasp! What are you doing lifting my chin up so... so...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Focus—have you made your choice, my
little
rambunctious princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You... you...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: RUDE BUFFOON!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You just... made a giant hole in the
wall...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ack! I've gone and done it again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pleeease, teachers, forgive me! I'll write
an
apology letter right this minute!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh... Ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're an interesting one, Kawakami
Princess.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaskfdf?! The chuckle, the suave
way she said
"interesting"—she's so
coool!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-this memory is going right in my
precious
archives of Tracen
Acade—gurk!
